verdict.rationale: Pulley docs show acceleration-on-exit handling and termination-triggered vesting stops, plus automatic vesting-event email alerts, indicating some automated vested/unvested tracking (pulley-docs-31, pulley-docs-32, pulley-docs-37). However there is no explicit documentation of defining custom cliffs or milestone-based vesting schedules, or a dashboard view showing vested vs unvested split. missing for 10: explicit cliff/milestone schedule configuration UI, a vested-vs-unvested tracking view/report, independent corroboration of automation accuracy.
